Welcome! Let’s step into a journey where faith, mystery, and the longing for connection all come together. Have you ever wondered how symbols and images can open new doors to experiencing the divine? Sometimes, it’s not words, but the quiet resonance of the heart that leads us closer to something greater.
In The Icon of the Divine Heart of God the Father: Apologia and Canon, Marcelle Bartolo-Abela invites us to explore a devotion that’s often overlooked—the gentle, yet powerful, focus on God the Father’s Heart. This isn’t just about admiring an icon; it’s about letting it become a living sign—something that draws us deeper into the mystery of divine love, mercy, and the relationship between Creator and creation.
As we move forward together, you’ll notice how the story weaves through centuries of spiritual reflection, history, and the rich tradition of Christian iconography. With each step, we’ll see how the defense and explanation—what Marcelle calls the apologia and canon—help us understand why this image matters, and how it can actually spark healing, renewal, and a profound sense of belonging in the embrace of the Father.
So, as we open our hearts to this invitation, let’s be curious. Let’s be ready for questions and moments of wonder. Together, we’re about to discover how the icon of the Divine Heart can become a pathway—one that leads us closer to the spiritual treasures waiting within.
